title: Phonetic profile is blind to the conjunct ksh-to-single-letter-x operation
why_real: Lakshmi and Laxmi are the same name under two romanizations, but the classic Metaphone coder assigns them different consonant skeletons, so a user who taught only 'Laxmi' gets no help at all — by either retriever — when a dictation produces 'Lakshmi'.

expected.reason: Metaphone keys for 'lakshmi' and 'laxmi' do not intersect, so neither exact nor phonetic retrieves a candidate; both abstain no_memory.
